Left male commander, right adult female sun-lancer. Framing head/crown to upper thighs with large clearly readable faces, equal character scale. Keep hair colors, weapon identity, main armor design and color-blocking recognizable. Simplify armor etching and ornaments to support the selected drawing style. No text, letters, numbers, card stats, logos or particles.
Critical anime requirements: Both faces are drawn with stylized anime eyes, simple drawn nose marks, clean drawn mouth shapes and clearly intentional 2D contours. Skin uses a base color and a few coherent designed shadow shapes, NO pores, skin texture, realistic soft rendered noses, photographic highlights, painterly flesh or lifelike eyes. Hair is designed as graphic colored locks, not individual realistic strands. Show armor thickness with overlapping shapes and shadow edges, NOT PBR reflections; show cloth weight through drawn folds, NOT photoreal fabric.
The male is a recognizable mature ANIME commander, around 40, solid shoulder and neck structure, broader shorter jaw than original, bold eyebrows, expressive confident eyes, short modest stubble rendered as a few drawn marks. Handsome and characterful, not an elongated pointed-chin bishonen teenager; not a giant bodybuilder or elderly bearded barbarian. The female remains a beautiful clearly adult ANIME heroine with expressive illustrated eyes, poised strong bearing and lovely face, not a lifelike Western model. Do not 'fix' anime by making faces realistic.
Draw BOTH characters in the option's same medium; character drawing must be visibly different from the previous rejected polished realistic style. The frame is only a context reference, do not let its material rendering dictate realistic character faces.
Selected direction: BOLD SHONEN / SEINEN ANIME CHARACTER DRAWING. Decisive clean ink contour with visible varied line weight; angular purposeful shape design; classic cel shading using 2 or 3 solid value groups and hard shadow boundaries. Stylized anatomy with solid torso and powerful, believable gesture; face features readable like a veteran commander in an anime key visual. Strong eyebrow/eye design, flattened designed cheek shadow, no realistic wrinkle rendering. Clear cobalt, gold and ivory colors, very limited gradients, a few broad flat highlight accents. Female stays elegant and beautiful, same strong drawn graphic style. Metal is a flat gold color with geometric lighter/shadow shapes, never reflective CG. The final image should read as a premium hand-drawn action-anime promotional illustration with dynamic line character and substantial costume forms.
